name: MIKE HADFIELD
title: IT Laboratory Systems Specialist

contacts.title: Phone number redacted — click to contact via form

profile: I've spent the last 12 years working for the UK's largest independent provider of clinical pathology. During that time I've had the opportunity to work on a large-scale project to replace our existing LIMS with an in-house bespoke solution, overseen two major laboratory moves, and learned the infrastructure for both our virtual and physical estates.

In addition to my personal growth, I've also taken on management roles in both laboratory and IT environments. This experience has expanded my skills and honed my ability to lead teams effectively towards achieving our objectives.

points: Configuration and implementation of a newly developed in-house LIMS system.
2nd line analyser support for 100+ analysers across the country.
Analyser interfacing, predominantly with HL7 and Mirth Connect.
Integration with associated middleware and client down-stream systems.
Microsoft SQL for database insertion and data queries.
Performing security updates to company-critical servers while maintaining minimal downtime.
Initial triage of all customer tickets.
First and second line desktop, laptop, and mobile support.
First line analyser and middleware support (Roche CITM, Sysmex EPU, Clinisys Winpath).
Active Directory and Microsoft Endpoint management.
Monitoring our virtual servers to diagnose issues and ensure good levels of performance.
General day-to-day site work (patching switches, imaging devices, installing equipment).
Promoted to team leader after one year in post.
Led a team of up to 12 staff, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.
Authored departmental SOPs, managed incident and GDPR reporting.
Held annual joint reviews, monthly team meetings, probationary and HR meetings.
Resolved queries and investigated problems with internal departments and external clients.
Maintained laboratory technical equipment, including centrifuges, scanners, and zebra printers.
Gained extensive knowledge of laboratory operations, procedures, and general pathology.
Managed and monitored attendance, sickness, productivity, and wages of all non-PAYE staff, maintaining accuracy and confidentiality of information.
Generated monthly activity reports to provide insights on courier trends and financials.
Managed the departmental email, phones, and courier software (DA Systems) for user and courier management, routes, and job assignment.
Transcribing patient demographic and coded test information from pathology requests.
Gained extensive knowledge in pathology sample handling and prerequisite testing requirements.
Collaborated with other staff to resolve queries, contributing to departmental SOPs and improved workflows.

interests.body: After needing to understand the basics of JavaScript for LIMS integration, in my spare time I've rediscovered an enjoyment for website creation and front end development. You can see (some of) my pet projects on [GitHub](https://github.com/mjhadfield).

interests.title: Programming
interests.body: In the new age of LLMs and neural networks, learning and creating has never been easier. Currently dabbling in Python.

interests.body: One of the best games ever created, up there with Chess. It helped fund me through university and remains a hobby ever since.
